Read any screen: audio, vocabulary and Claude grammar

Lets Supernova lock the screen from a gesture and, when you double-tap the back of the phone (or tap 読), capture a screen region for Japanese reading. The motion sensor is watched only while the screen is on, for that knock. OCR and dictionary lookups run on your phone. Text is sent to the speech service when you listen, and to Claude only when you ask for an explanation.
